product_metadata.title: BISSELL® MYair® Pro Air Purifier with HEPA and Carbon Filter for Small Room, Quiet Bedroom Air Cleaner for Allergens, Pets, Dust, Dander, Pollen, Smoke, Odors, 3139B , Black
features: Every Purchase Saves Pets. BISSELL proudly supports BISSELL Pet Foundation and its mission to help save homeless pets.
Small Room Filtration. Perfect for small to medium rooms, including nurseries, bedrooms, offices, and dorms.

AHAM Verifide. Filters rooms 110 sq ft providing 4.8 air changes/hour, or one change every 12 minutes. Filters 177 sq ft with three air changes/hour. Filters 266 sq ft with two air changes/hour. Filters 532 sq ft with one air change/hour.
Simply Clean Air with 360 Degrees of Filtration. 3-in-1 pre-, HEPA and carbon filter captures large and fine particles, home odors, odors from pets, and VOCs.
Medical-Grade HEPA Filter. Effectively captures 99.97% of particles 0.3 microns and smaller when on lowest fan speed, helping to remove airborne irritants like dust, pet dander, pollen, and smoke.
Low Energy & Whisper Quiet. Energy Star certified and equipped with three fan speeds, the lowest of them working at a calming 29 dB(A).
Adjustable Soft Glow Night Light. Choose from no light, low or high, and any brightness in-between simply by pressing, holding and releasing the button at your desired level.

Easy Filter Maintenance. Filter change indicator will tell you when it’s time for new filters. Filters should be replaced approx. every four months. Use BISSELL Replacement Filters to ensure excellent performance. AMAZON ONLY: Search B09BVZRMPP to find the correct filter for your air purifier.
description: Get Simply Clean Air™ from the brand you've trusted to clean your floors for over 145 years with BISSELL® MYair® Pro air purifier. With its intuitive controls, getting clean indoor air has never been easier. Air flows in through the sides of MYair® Pro air purifier and passes through its 3-in-1 HEPA, carbon and pre-filter, which makes capturing unwanted allergens, irritants and odors in your home’s air a breeze. MYair® Pro air purifier has three fan speeds that operate at pleasant-sounding levels, the lowest of which is a whisper-quiet sound, so it’s perfect for bedrooms or nurseries. It also has a unique night light that can be turned on and off or set to low or high, and any brightness in between simply by pressing, holding and releasing at the level you prefer. The compact size and versatility of MYair® Pro air purifier also make it easy to incorporate into any room in your home, and it’s ideal for purifying those smaller spaces like a home office. And every purchase of this air purifier helps save pets! BISSELL proudly supports BISSELL Pet Foundation® and its mission to help save homeless pets. We’re proud to design products that help make pet messes, odors and pet homelessness disappear.

details.Care instructions: Replace filter every four months. Use BISSELL® Replacement Filters to ensure excellent performance.
